room.name: [Bosque Deriel, Hermit's Shacks] (230008)
room.description: Here on the route between the sacred sites of the Observatory and the Faery Ring is a semi-circular clearing. At its center stands a hut made of lashed branches, roofed with broad leaves. A certain sect of Elven clerics, who are renowned for their devotion to contemplation, are wont to retire into the solitudes of the woods and groves hereabouts. They are not, however, renowned for their hospitality.
room.players: Also here: Druid Delphine and Corwin.

component: The darkness of the woods is almost absolute here, making you lose all sense of time and place. Low locust trees line the path, their long, thin pods hanging down like serpents ready to drop and squeeze your last life's breath out of you. Looking at the ground, you notice a diamond-backed snake slowly coiling its way into a hollow root cave.
Obvious paths: south, northwest.

room.name: [Bosque Deriel, Dense Woods] (230009)
room.description: The darkness of the woods is almost absolute here, making you lose all sense of time and place. Low locust trees line the path, their long, thin pods hanging down like serpents ready to drop and squeeze your last life's breath out of you. Looking at the ground, you notice a diamond-backed snake slowly coiling its way into a hollow root cave.

component: Something brownish-green darts through the branches overhead, and suddenly falls at your feet with a *THWAP*! The chameleon skitters away, and hot on its tail, out of nowhere, bursts an Elven child, clad in brownish green like its quarry. Amid shrieks of delight, the child pursues the lizard as they both melt into the forest. To the north, the land becomes more open and grassy, rising slightly, while to the south are clumps of trees.
Obvious paths: north, southeast.

room.name: [Bosque Deriel, Dense Woods] (230010)

component: You come upon a circular clearing, wreathed in mist and ringed by the largest toadstools you have ever seen. The haze curls around the base and beneath the caps of the gigantic mushrooms, creeping noiselessly along and from time to time assuming fanciful Elven shapes. Inside the ring, the dirt is trodden down, and the grass does not grow, as if a circle dance of intense frenzy had been performed here night after night, since before time was.
Obvious paths: north, south, west.

room.name: [Bosque Deriel, Trelda's Faery Ring] (230011)
room.description: You come upon a circular clearing, wreathed in mist and ringed by the largest toadstools you have ever seen. The haze curls around the base and beneath the caps of the gigantic mushrooms, creeping noiselessly along and from time to time assuming fanciful Elven shapes. Inside the ring, the dirt is trodden down, and the grass does not grow, as if a circle dance of intense frenzy had been performed here night after night, since before time was.

component: Due east, a clearing atop a small grassy hill rises to a point. At its summit you can barely make out a circular growth of plants at regularly-spaced intervals. To the southwest is E'erdream Bower gate, through which lies the Elven stronghold of Leth Deriel. Thick stands of deobar trees form an impenetrable wall around the city on either side of the arching canopy of E'erdream trees.
You also see an ancient deobar tree.
Obvious paths: northeast, east, southwest.

room.name: [Bosque Deriel, Grove Lawn] (230029)
room.description: Due east, a clearing atop a small grassy hill rises to a point. At its summit you can barely make out a circular growth of plants at regularly-spaced intervals. To the southwest is E'erdream Bower gate, through which lies the Elven stronghold of Leth Deriel. Thick stands of deobar trees form an impenetrable wall around the city on either side of the arching canopy of E'erdream trees.
room.exists: You also see an ancient deobar tree.

component: You could listen to the melody of the calling birds here in the greenwood for what would seem to be mere minutes but when roused from your reverie, actual years, so enchanting and vibrant are their songs at this gate. Brilliant E'erdream trees form colonnades on either side of the way, leading southwest back into the heart of town, and northeast to a grassy hillock.
Obvious paths: southwest.

room.name: [Leth Deriel, E'erdream Bower Gate] (100065)
room.description: You could listen to the melody of the calling birds here in the greenwood for what would seem to be mere minutes but when roused from your reverie, actual years, so enchanting and vibrant are their songs at this gate. Brilliant E'erdream trees form colonnades on either side of the way, leading southwest back into the heart of town, and northeast to a grassy hillock.

component: The deobars thin out, leaving the path northeast to E'erdream Bower Gate lined only with straight, wispy E'erdream trees. Their lacy foliage sways lazily overhead and the fragrance of their flowers fills your nostrils. The soft beds of fallen leaves at their bases look like the perfect spot for a short nap.
Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest.

room.name: [Leth Deriel, Elder Bark Circle] (100029)
room.description: The deobars thin out, leaving the path northeast to E'erdream Bower Gate lined only with straight, wispy E'erdream trees. Their lacy foliage sways lazily overhead and the fragrance of their flowers fills your nostrils. The soft beds of fallen leaves at their bases look like the perfect spot for a short nap.
room.exits: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest.

component: The trees converge here, and their crowns spread out to meet in a canopy of leafy boughs. Passing through this soothing and shady tunnel of foliage, the songs of the feathered sylvan orchestra overhead are amplified as they warble their myriad hymns to the ageless deities who watch over Leth Deriel.
Obvious paths: northeast, southwest.

room.name: [Leth Deriel, Lorethew Lerili Road] (100064)
room.description: The trees converge here, and their crowns spread out to meet in a canopy of leafy boughs. Passing through this soothing and shady tunnel of foliage, the songs of the feathered sylvan orchestra overhead are amplified as they warble their myriad hymns to the ageless deities who watch over Leth Deriel.

component: The leafy tunnel overhead provides a highway for fuzzy tailed squirrels, fat-cheeked chipmunks, and darting greenish-brown lizards. A few stray acorns fall to the ground with a dull thud, missing you by a narrow margin. A break in the hedgerow to the south leads to a hut with a smoking chimney, from which wafts the unmistakable aroma of baking bread.
Obvious paths: northeast, southwest.

room.name: [Leth Deriel, Lorethew Lerili Road] (100063)

component: An ancient banyan tree, the town's main temple, looms to the southwest, as pilgrims come and go in a steady, quiet stream. Not only are there clerics, empaths, mages and other devotees of the spiritual in the mix, but more secular types also seem to cluster around the temple. Its dark, leathery leaves rustle on high, maintaining rhythm with the intoned prayers, chants and hymns of worshippers gathered in its precincts.
Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest.

component: One great tree, looking almost as old as Sana'ati Dyaus itself, nearly blocks the path here. Its roots are a jumbled network of tendrils reaching above the surface and out across the road. Sheets of bark are sloughing off the trunk in spots, and the tree throws its branches out wildly in all directions, as though casting jealously about to snare those beings fortunate enough not be rooted where they stand.
You also see some construction around the base of the tree.
Obvious paths: southeast, northwest.

component: This is a busy junction, leading to and from the main clearing of town, as well as a good many vital shops and institutions, such as the Imperial Depository due west, the provisions store due east, and the main temple to the northwest. The well trodden path extends a bit beneath shady plane trees on either side, fading off into a dense cover of large bracken, their tough stalks and lacy fronds sprouting up at all angles.
Obvious paths: east, southwest, west, northwest.

room.name: [Leth Deriel, Cambium Circle] (100051)

room.exits: Obvious paths: east, southwest, west, northwest.

component: A tall, smooth barked ebonwood tree dominates the southwest side of the road here. Its strong, black walls form a perfect circular trunk of huge diameter. All the low hanging branches have been trimmed to prevent climbing. An ebony door, fashioned with exquisite metal fittings and inlaid with semi-precious gems, marks this tree as the seat of Leth Deriel's financial life, the Imperial Depository.
Obvious paths: east, west.

component: The inside of the lobby here is breathtaking, unlike anything else you have seen so far in Leth Deriel in terms of its display of wealth and worldliness. The interior of the ebonwood tree has been polished and grooved to resemble rich paneling. A brass sign along the far wall points up.
Obvious exits: up, out.

room.name: [Imperial Depository, Lobby] (103021)
room.description: The inside of the lobby here is breathtaking, unlike anything else you have seen so far in Leth Deriel in terms of its display of wealth and worldliness. The interior of the ebonwood tree has been polished and grooved to resemble rich paneling. A brass sign along the far wall points up.

component: Here at the inside of a large fork is a chamber that houses the tellers for local currency transactions. Despite their rather conservative nature, the local merchants, traders and citizens seem to be conducting a fair amount of business. A sign points up for the Foreign Branch.
You also see a small calendar and a beautifully penned scroll.
Obvious exits: up, down.

Its dark, leathery leaves rustle on high, maintaining rhythm with the intoned prayers, chants and hymns of worshippers gathered in its precincts.
room.exits: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest.

component: The leafy tunnel overhead provides a highway for fuzzy tailed squirrels, fat-cheeked chipmunks, and darting greenish-brown lizards. A few stray acorns fall to the ground with a dull thud, missing you by a narrow margin. A break in the hedgerow to the south leads to a hut with a smoking chimney, from which wafts the unmistakable aroma of baking bread.
Obvious paths: northeast, southwest.

component: The trees converge here, and their crowns spread out to meet in a canopy of leafy boughs. Passing through this soothing and shady tunnel of foliage, the songs of the feathered sylvan orchestra overhead are amplified as they warble their myriad hymns to the ageless deities who watch over Leth Deriel.
Obvious paths: northeast, southwest.

component: The deobars thin out, leaving the path northeast to E'erdream Bower Gate lined only with straight, wispy E'erdream trees. Their lacy foliage sways lazily overhead and the fragrance of their flowers fills your nostrils. The soft beds of fallen leaves at their bases look like the perfect spot for a short nap.
You also see an Elven Warden.
Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest.

You could listen to the melody of the calling birds here in the greenwood for what would seem to be mere minutes but when roused from your reverie, actual years, so enchanting and vibrant are their songs at this gate. Brilliant E'erdream trees form colonnades on either side of the way, leading southwest back into the heart of town, and northeast to a grassy hillock.
Obvious paths: southwest.

component: Due east, a clearing atop a small grassy hill rises to a point. At its summit you can barely make out a circular growth of plants at regularly-spaced intervals. To the southwest is E'erdream Bower gate, through which lies the Elven stronghold of Leth Deriel. Thick stands of deobar trees form an impenetrable wall around the city on either side of the arching canopy of E'erdream trees.
You also see an ancient deobar tree.
Obvious paths: northeast, east, southwest.

component: You come upon a circular clearing, wreathed in mist and ringed by the largest toadstools you have ever seen. The haze curls around the base and beneath the caps of the gigantic mushrooms, creeping noiselessly along and from time to time assuming fanciful Elven shapes. Inside the ring, the dirt is trodden down, and the grass does not grow, as if a circle dance of intense frenzy had been performed here night after night, since before time was.
Obvious paths: north, south, west.

component: Something brownish-green darts through the branches overhead, and suddenly falls at your feet with a *THWAP*! The chameleon skitters away, and hot on its tail, out of nowhere, bursts an Elven child, clad in brownish green like its quarry. Amid shrieks of delight, the child pursues the lizard as they both melt into the forest. To the north, the land becomes more open and grassy, rising slightly, while to the south are clumps of trees.
Obvious paths: north, southeast.

component: The darkness of the woods is almost absolute here, making you lose all sense of time and place. Low locust trees line the path, their long, thin pods hanging down like serpents ready to drop and squeeze your last life's breath out of you. Looking at the ground, you notice a diamond-backed snake slowly coiling its way into a hollow root cave.
Obvious paths: south, northwest.

component: Here on the route between the sacred sites of the Observatory and the Faery Ring is a semi-circular clearing. At its center stands a hut made of lashed branches, roofed with broad leaves. A certain sect of Elven clerics, who are renowned for their devotion to contemplation, are wont to retire into the solitudes of the woods and groves hereabouts. They are not, however, renowned for their hospitality.
Also here: Druid Delphine and Corwin.
Obvious paths: north, south.
